name: Mystical Power
description: You attack by emitting mystical power. Make a ranged attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. If the attack hit, you gain +1 to all attack rolls made with INT, WIS, or CHA as the Move Power until the end of the encounter or until switched out. If the attack missed, you gain +1 AC until the end of the encounter or until switched out. The sum of these bonuses cap at +5 total.
